::: {.column-page} Hello! 🤗 I’m **Peyman Kor**, a **Data Scientist** with a **Ph.D. in Machine Learning** from the University of Stavanger. I specialize in applying advanced data science techniques and machine learning algorithms to solve real-world problems. I have over three years of experience developing machine learning models for **optimization**, **decision-making**, and driving impactful results across industries such as **energy** and **finance**. --- ### Projects and Expertise - **Decision Analysis and Optimization:** - Expertise in applying sequential decision-making frameworks, dynamic programming, and reinforcement learning techniques. - **Machine Learning for Financial Engineering:** - Developed Q-learning algorithms to optimize policies for American options pricing, showing the power of reinforcement learning in financial modeling. - **Bayesian Optimization and Stochastic Processes:** - I applied Bayesian methods to optimize complex processes, such as well control in oil production, achieving superior results compared to traditional algorithms. --- ### Technical Skills - **Programming:** - Proficient in **Python**, **R**, and **SQL**, with a strong background in libraries such as **Pandas**, **Scikit-learn**, **PyTorch**, and **XGBoost**. - **Big Data:** - Experienced in **PySpark** for handling large-scale datasets. - **Cloud/DevOps:** - Familiar with cloud services like **Microsoft Azure** and **AWS**, and containerization tools like **Docker**. - **Version Control and Collaboration:** - Skilled in using **Git** and **GitHub** for version control and team collaboration. I aim to leverage my academic expertise and hands-on project experience to solve industry challenges in **Data Science**, **Machine Learning**, and **AI**, driving innovation and delivering data-driven solutions. --- ## Education - **Ph.D. in Computational Engineering**, [University of Stavanger](https://www.uis.no/en), 2021 - Present - **MSc in Computational Modeling and Applied Mathematics (non-degree)**, [Technical University of Denmark](https://www.dtu.dk/english/), 2019-2020 - **MSc in Reservoir Engineering**, University of Stavanger, Norway, 2017-2019 - **BSc in Reservoir Engineering**, Petroleum University of Technology, Iran, 2011-2016
